prompt: How much storage do I get with the free plan?
completion: The CloudStore free plan includes 10GB of storage space. You can upgrade anytime to get more storage and additional features.

prompt: I forgot my password. What should I do?
completion: No problem! Click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page. Enter your email address, and we'll send you a password reset link within 5 minutes. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.

prompt: Can I share files with people who don't have CloudStore?
completion: Absolutely! You can create a shareable link for any file or folder. Go to the file, click the share icon, and copy the link. Anyone with the link can view or download the file, even without a CloudStore account.
CloudStore supports all file types! You can upload documents, images, videos, audio files, archives, and more. There's no restriction on file formats.
Yes, security is our top priority. All files are encrypted in transit using TLS and at rest using AES-256 encryption. Only you have access to your encryption keys.

prompt: How do I cancel my subscription?
completion: You can cancel anytime from your account settings. Go to Settings > Subscription > Cancel Plan. You'll retain access until the end of your billing period, and your data will remain available.

prompt: What's the difference between the Pro and Business plans?
completion: The Pro plan ($9.99/month) gives you 1TB storage and priority support. The Business plan ($19.99/month) includes 5TB storage, team collaboration features, admin controls, and advanced security options.
Yes! Deleted files go to the Trash where they're kept for 30 days. During this time, you can restore them anytime. After 30 days, files are permanently deleted.
